# Joplin MCP for Claude and ChatGPT

> Open-source bridge that connects Claude, ChatGPT and any MCP client to
> self-hosted Joplin notes: local stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP, a Claude
> connector with GitHub login, authenticated ChatGPT Actions, an automated
> headless Linux service, and reviewable two-way Markdown sync.

Canonical documentation: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/
Source: https://github.com/kogeler/joplin-md-sync
Package: https://pypi.org/project/joplin-md-sync/

<!-- pages -->

## Agent safety

- Pull before editing.
- Keep managed metadata headers intact.
- Review a three-way diff and `push --dry-run` before a real push.
- Do not edit `.joplin-sync/`.
- Do not interleave MCP writes with unpushed local edits.
- Do not expose the Joplin Data API to a network.
- Never put a Joplin, MCP, Actions, GitHub OAuth, sync, or encryption credential in
  chat, Git, logs, or command arguments.
